title: Tune-Up
author: Claude
blurb: It's the morning of the Clown Club parade, and THE CHEZ honks like a kazoo: Gwinn tipped the instrument trunk into the hood. With no wrenches, Doc Leo shrinks down and tunes it up by ear, with Sir Reginald III, his rubber chicken, doing the fiddly bits.

box.levels: 9 levels: a dream of an engine bay, then the real electric car, a cartoon before each
box.tagline: No wrenches. No problem. Just a really good ear.
box.back:
It's the morning of the Clown Club parade, and THE CHEZ is meant to lead it. But overnight Gwinn buried Doc Leo's toolbox and tipped the instrument trunk into the open hood, and now the car honks like a kazoo.

So Doc Leo does his shrinking trick and climbs inside to tune it up by ear. Crank the battery to a bugle's "Charge!", pluck the spark plugs like harp strings between the sparks, play the timing back into step on a player piano's four pipes, and oil the Squeaks off the staff.

Sir Reginald III, his rubber chicken, does the fiddly bits. Formally.
features: Doc Leo and Sir Reginald III, his rubber chicken, talk over every repair
Crank the battery while its gauge fills, and hear the bugle call "Charge!"
Pluck the spark plugs like harp strings while the sparks run in firing order
The Timing Beat: notes drop down four glass pipes onto four keys, in three verses
Oil's Well: Z X C V B squirt the oil can up the five lines of a staff
A Hat Sting cartoon before every level, and a cutaway CHEZ that lights up as it's tuned
Sound Blaster music for every part of the engine, and a note for everything you fix
